description: tangent-outside-cut's tool moved a quarter of a tolerance (1e-7) across the contact, into the plate (d > 0) and away from it (d < 0): within the tolerance the pose is the contact's, and the result is the plate with every id kept, as tangent-outside-cut is (plans/c3-tolerance-apart step 9, the band's ends).

analytic.counts_differ: Open CASCADE imprints the tangent ruling on the touched face, as at the contact (tangent-outside-cut); Arris keeps the face whole — within the tolerance the touch removes no material
